title: Impulse Space careers pair
description: A white section: a 40px heading with a light-up pill beside it, then two large photo cards with 16px corners (side by side and square on desktop, stacked and tall on phones). Each card carries a white 20px title and mono label over a dark bottom gradient; on hover the photo settles from a slight zoom to full size.
notes: photos are slots (media per card); empty, each is a muted placeholder
the caption shade is a .dark scope, so it stays dark in both modes
